pages.text: Snow had fallen softly all night. A white blanket covered the alley.
Nobody had stepped in the snow. Coco would make the first footprints.
While Coco put on boots, a swish, swish came from outside.
Mr. Pig was sweeping away the snow. "I'll clear the front of the shop!"
Swish, swish. Little by little, the white alley became a dark stone path.
Coco opened the door and went out. There was... hardly any snow.
Coco's shoulders drooped. Only then did Mr. Pig notice Coco's boots.
"Oh dear." He quickly hid the broom behind his back.
Some snow remained in a corner of the alley, where the broom hadn't reached.
Crunch, crunch. Coco's footprints appeared. Beside them were big footprints too. They were Mr. Pig's.
